# War Scroll Column 16 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 16 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**16:1** [...] the priests shall blow on the trumpets [...] for the arrangement of the battle lines [...]

**16:2** [...] and on the trumpets of assembly they shall blow a sustained note for the directing of the battle [...]

**16:3** [...they shall begin] to bring down the slain. And all the people shall cease the war cry, but the priests shall continue to blow

**16:4** on the trumpets of the slain to direct the battle, until the enemy is struck down and they turn

**16:5** in retreat. And the priests shall blow to direct the battle. And when they are defeated

**16:6** before them, the priests shall blow the trumpets of assembly, and all the front-line infantry shall go out

**16:7** to them from among the fallen of the front ranks, and six divisions shall take their stand. And the division going forth

**16:8** with its weapons of war shall station itself at its assigned position. And six further divisions shall take position,

**16:9** all of them together: twenty-six divisions. And the cavalry on the right and on the left

**16:10** of the battle line shall stand: six hundred on one side and six hundred on the other.

**16:11** And when Belial girds himself to aid the Sons of Darkness, and the slain among the infantry begin to fall

**16:12** through the mysteries of God, testing all those appointed for battle — the priests

**16:13** shall blow the trumpets of summoning for another battle line to go forth as a replacement force

**16:14** [...] and the priests shall blow for them the signals to draw up the ranks [...]

**16:15** [...] and with the sounding of the priests [...] to test through these mysteries [...all those appointed]

**16:16** for the battle [...] and the warriors of [...] the war [...] the God of Israel [...]

**16:17** [...] for all the appointed times of eternity [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS formal register throughout, with EMET's "weapons of war" (16:8) preferred over LOGOS "battle equipment" as standard biblical idiom for kelei milchamah. EMET's "bring down" (16:3) preferred over LOGOS "fell" as more transparent. "Mysteries" retained as standard rendering of raz per project convention. PNEUMA's "hidden purposes" rejected as over-interpretive. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
